'''Michael Schneider''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Schneider was born on January 29, 1987, and grew up on Long Island. He became a voice actor as an adult and joined the franchise during {{aniseries|HZ}}, gaining the role of [[Zirc]] in addition to a number of other roles including {{DL|Coral|Glalie|Coral's Glalie}}.
